column1: # Mutants of recipe durable-extent-store-20261107 (differential.sh lane e): each row replaces an exact text (\n separates lines) exactly once in the relocated M3DurableExtentStore.java copied to the scratch directory; the mutant is compiled with M3ContentExtent and must be killed by at least one gate: the relocated JUnit classes (target/test-classes on the mutant), the differential dump (identical to the relocated dump = survived), the crash gate (CRASH PASS = survived). differential.sh prints each gate's verdict per mutant.
